red4.honestResult: FAIL (bytes differ) with named cause, per dispatch: do not weaken the assertion. Only mesh Cube.003 of 45 differs (4 vertices); all baked images bit-identical including the 145906B floor photo; JSON structure identical. Cause: stage-1 post-generate bytes already differed between the two runs (workGlbSha256 6106a52a vs dfeecfac) while every other finish key input (params, env, blenderVersion, infinigen commit+decorate, patches, all script hashes, upstream key f59df540) was EQUAL -- so the 4-vertex delta comes from generate/simplify nondeterminism (Infinigen draw or meshopt vertex order), inherited downstream. The finish stage's own bake/paint work is deterministic on identical input bytes. Cache serve integrity separately verified: stored entry bytes == restored bytes (15a8ef97 both sides).

warmPathScrubBug.detail: first warm run (3s) hit generate+finish but MISSED lighting on the absolute outDir path alone (key 26ceea1a, junk entry, since removed from the live tree by key rotation)
warmPathScrubBug.fixCommit: b19927174 scrubs roomGlbPath to basename in the lighting key (bytes stay keyed via workGlbSha256); unit test locks outDir-independence plus byte sensitivity
warmPathScrubBug.knownCaveat: designLightingRig seeds its jitter PRNG over the canonical input INCLUDING roomGlbPath, so rig light positions jitter ~10cm between outDirs while energies/sizes/counts are identical; restored rig JSONs therefore carry their origin outDir's roomGlbPath and jitter. Cross-outDir lighting cache hits serve an equivalent (not bitwise-identical-to-fresh) rig. Kept deliberately: the dispatch requires warm-run all-hit, and the rig pass costs ~1s.
